Hi Marissa,

Thanks for sending the draft MSA. Our security team reviewed the security exhibit and a few of the audit-rights sections and flagged items that are blockers for procurement. High-level asks below and I attached our requirements file for reference: Customer_Sec_Reqs_Accordion.pdf.

- SOC 2: We need an annual SOC 2 Type II report for the control period covering systems that process our data. We also require evidence cadence: SOC access or report within 30 days of request for up to 2 requests per 12 months.
- Pen tests: We need high-level third-party pen test summaries (not raw PII) annually, and the right to request a remediation plan within 30 days after report delivery.
- Audit rights: We prefer explicit audit rights (on-site or remote) but will accept a third-party assessor with reasonable scope. We need clarity on notice period (we propose 30 business days) and a limitation to systems processing our data only.
- Confidentiality of reports: SOC/pen test artifacts should be covered under NDA with clear handling rules.

Can you please loop in your legal and security teams so we can get redline responses? We have an internal procurement deadline of 2026-03-12 to finalize the MSA and Order Form.

Team — I reviewed Acme’s asks and prepared an internal negotiation playbook and tracked-change redline (see attached). Summary of our recommended position and fallback:

- SOC 2: Offer annual SOC 2 Type II report covering Redwood’s production environment. We provide the report under NDA within 30 days of a verified business request. Fallback: allow up to 2 requests per rolling 12 months; any additional requests require discretionary approval and cost-recovery.

- Pen tests: Agree to deliver redacted, signed executive summaries of third-party penetration tests annually (+ after material remediation). We will commit to a remediation plan within 30 calendar days after delivery of the summary. We will not provide raw test output or internal tool configurations.

- Audit rights: Counter-proposal — remote, scoped assessment by an independent third-party assessor approved by Redwood (mutually acceptable). Notice period: 45 days. Frequency: once per 12 months; additional audits allowed only after a material security incident or with cost recovery. Scope limited to systems and logs necessary to validate controls for Acme’s data. We also recommend adding an explicit confidentiality carve-out for shared artifacts and a small window to redact proprietary tool output.

- Evidence cadence: Recommend standard template (SOC2 summary + control mappings) and a 10-business-day window to deliver standard evidence packs after request. For more complex evidence requests (e.g., live environment metrics), request a statement of work and timing estimate.

Negotiation approach: Offer the above as the baseline; accept Acme's request for 30 days for report delivery if they commit to NDA and agree to the 2-requests-per-year cap. This preserves operational feasibility while addressing procurement.

Attachments: Redwood_MSA_Exhibit_Security_redlines_20260302.pdf; SOC2-evidence-cadence-table.xlsx
